# dsh-latex
> **English** | 中文
Make the DeepSeek Harness chat render formulae as formulae, and make the model **write LaTeX by defa
ult** instead of wrapping math in `latex` fences.
## What it fixes
DSH's frontend already renders TeX through KaTeX (`MarkdownText` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-prim
already renders TeX through KaTeX (`MarkdownText` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`), but:
| Symptom | Cause | What this plugin does |

| Formulae show up as a grey code block | The model writes them in
[代码示例省略，未执行]
powershell
dsh plugi
n --profile desktop add github:sbVAN/dsh-latex

[代码示例省略，未执行]

": "link:Z:/文件留存/deepseek project/dsh-latex"
# 2. create the junction (the equivalent of pnpm's link

:)
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-late

x" `
-Target "Z:\文件留存\deepseek project\dsh-latex"
# 3. append to the profile's cordis.patch.yml:
#

- insert:

half needs the new composition)

[代码示例省略，未执行]
yaml
- insert:
- id: latex
name: dsh-latex
config:
mode: auto
strict: true
compact: fal

se
locale: zh
extraRules:
- Write water as $\mathrm{H_2O}$, never \ce{}.
```
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `mode` | `auto` | `auto` injects only after the conversation shows math (no tax on every chat); `a

lways` injects in every session; `off` never injects |
| `enabled` | `true` | Compatibility: `false`

is equivalent to `mode: off` |
| `locale` | `auto` | `zh` / `en` / `auto` (auto follows `DSH_LOCALE

`, `LANG`, defaulting to Chinese) |
| `strict` | `true` | `true` forbids fenced formulae; `false` on

ly recommends |
| `compact` | `false` | Shorter prompt, roughly 1/3 of the tokens |
| `order` | `145

` | Section order inside the system prompt (tool guidance owns 100–199) |
| `extraRules` | `[]` | Ex
tra bullet lines appended to the contract |
## Behaviour
### Host half (`lib/index.js`)
With `mode: always` it registers a **global** `ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'dsh-latex:math-outp
ut', order, text })`. With `mode: auto` (default) no global section is registered: it listens on `ag
ent/pre-step`, and only after a user message carries a math signal (math delimiters, TeX commands, o
r keywords such as integral/matrix/equation) does it register a **scoped** section through that sess
ion's `agent.ctx` — the section follows that session and is disposed with it, so chats that never to
uch math pay nothing. The contract covers inline `$...$`, single-line display `$$...$$` blocks (a mu
lti-line block loses its delimiter pairing and renders as source), a ban on fenced formulae, the KaT
eX-supported subset (`aligned` over `align`, `pmatrix`/`bmatrix`/`cases`, `\mathrm{}` over `\si{}`/`
\pu{}`/`\ce{}`, no `\label`/`\tag`), CJK only inside `\text{}`, splitting long derivations, and `\lv
ert ... \rvert` (never `|` or `\left|`) inside table cells.
In `always` mode the global section is disposed with the plugin fiber; in `auto` mode the scoped sec
tions live with their sessions and are withdrawn on plugin reload. The rendered contract is written
to `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-latex/prompt.txt`, mount diagnostics to `mounted.json`.
### Browser half (`lib/client.js`)

- display-math scrolling and an error badge;
- `pre > code.language-latex|tex` gets a preview below

it, rendered with the shared `MarkdownText` (no bundled KaTeX), source folded by default;
- toolbar

with show/hide source and copy LaTeX;
- **copy source**: a hover button on each display block copies
the original TeX from KaTeX's MathML annotation (`annotation[encoding="application/x-tex"]`); selec
ting a rendered formula and pressing Ctrl+C yields that same source instead of the newline-heavy spa

n text;
- 300 ms debounce over a full scan, orphan cleanup, and root unmount when React replaces nod

ext;
- 300 ms debounce over a full scan, orphan cleanup, and root unmount when React replaces nodes.
## Limitations
- **No math while streaming** — that is the frontend's deliberate behaviour and this plugin does not

fight it.
- **Only `latex` / `tex` fences are handled** — `math` fences are already rendered upstre

am.
- **No mhchem** — `\ce{}` / `\pu{}` still fail; the prompt routes them to `\mathrm{}`.
- **No `c
onversation.chat.node` takeover** — replacing the assistant renderer means duplicating the whole mes

sage structure and breaks on upstream upgrades.
- **No history rewriting** — the prompt constrains f

uture output only; old sessions are covered by the browser half.
- **`auto` is heuristic** — it keys
off math syntax and keywords, so it can miss (e.g. you only paste code and ask for a fix) or fire e

arly; use `mode: always` when a session must carry the contract from the first turn.
- **A bare `|`
in a table cell breaks the formula** — GFM reads it as a column separator, so `$\oint_{|z|=1}$` gets
split across cells and renders as raw text. The prompt now requires `\vert` / `\lvert ... \rvert`;

messages already sent cannot be repaired because the table was split at parse time.
- **Parse failur
es no longer flood the page**: when a whole paragraph ends up inside one formula and KaTeX rejects i
t, parse-failure blocks are neutral instead of red; long ones collapse to three lines and expand on
click. Display blocks need their opening and closing `$$` on their own lines — this failure is almos
t always a closing `$$` appended to the end of a formula.

> Note: the browser half anchors on `.md-code-block` and reads the language from
> the header banner

, because the rendered code block carries no `language-*`
> class on `pre`/`code`. See `lib/client.j
s` for the exact DOM contract.
## Rollback
Remove the junction, drop the insert line from `cordis.patch.yml`, restore the profile `package.json
`, restart. No DSH file is modified.
